close_reason: Delivered in PR #258 (audited 2026-09-06: FDB anchor encodings for fgoe/lloe, position arithmetic rewritten, backward continuation restored; 7 tests plus 10,200-case differential check; CI green)
description: Flagged by fresh-agent audit of bedrock-v2c: index_manager.ex calculate_target_position_found/not_found (lines ~342-360) look inconsistent with KeySelector constructor encodings — e.g. last_less_or_equal(k) resolves to k's predecessor when k exists (pos + (-1) with or_equal: true), and first_greater_than(k) when k is absent computes insertion_pos + 1, skipping one key. Also LayoutIndex.get_next_segment/get_previous_segment cross-shard continuation appears to be dead code (no callers). Needs falsifiable spike per spike-before-fixing before any fix.

comments.text: Draft PR: https://github.com/bedrock-kv/bedrock/pull/258 — KeySelector re-encoded to FDB's KeySelectorRef (fgoe -> {false,+1}, lloe -> {true,0}) and Olivine's resolver rewritten to anchor+offset; cross-page continuation now carries a signed residual, which also made backward continuation reachable for the first time. The ticket's LayoutIndex.get_next_segment/get_previous_segment observation is already moot: both were removed in 1b9921b8. Cold audit PASS-WITH-NOTES (differential model over 10,200 cases: 0 mismatches here, 1,991 on develop).

title: Olivine selector position arithmetic inconsistent with KeySelector constructor encodings
